paperTitle: CancerSB: A Serious Adventure Game for Bone Cancer Education and Awareness with ChatGPT 4o-driven Preliminary Validation
centralContribution: This study introduces CancerSB, a serious adventure game designed to raise awareness and provide education about bone cancer through an engaging point-and-click experience. The paper also presents a novel preliminary validation methodology utilizing ChatGPT 4o to generate simulated user feedback from diverse "mega-personas," guiding early design choices before real user testing.

elements.name: CancerSB
elements.description: A serious adventure game designed to raise awareness and provide education about bone cancer through an engaging point-and-click experience, developed in Unity in collaboration with medical professionals.
elements.justification: CancerSB is the central artifact and primary contribution of the paper, addressing the lack of engaging educational resources for bone cancer. Its development and features are the core subject.

elements.name: Preliminary Validation Methodology using ChatGPT 4o
elements.description: A novel methodology utilizing ChatGPT 4o to generate simulated user feedback from diverse 'mega-personas,' guiding early design choices before real user testing of the game.
elements.justification: This methodology represents a significant and innovative contribution, offering a new approach to early-stage user testing and feedback collection for serious games.

elements.name: Lack of Engaging Educational Resources for Bone Cancer
elements.description: Despite bone cancer's significant impact, particularly on adolescents and young adults, there is a noted absence of specific, engaging educational materials like serious games and simulators.
elements.justification: This problem statement provides the fundamental motivation and context for the development of CancerSB, highlighting the critical gap the paper aims to fill.

elements.name: Mega-personas Approach
elements.description: An approach for preliminary validation that uses ChatGPT 4o to simulate feedback from four diverse user profiles: The Informed Patient, The Curious Student, The Healthcare Professional, and The Casual Gamer.
elements.justification: This approach is integral to the paper's novel validation methodology, defining the simulated user profiles from which feedback is generated.

elements.name: Culturally Themed World Regions
elements.description: Three distinct in-game regions (Chile, Italy, China) that symbolize specific bone regions affected by distinct cancer types, with architectural landmarks mapped onto a human skeleton (FIG 3) for educational clarity.
elements.justification: These regions form the structural and narrative backbone of CancerSB, embedding educational content about different bone cancer types within culturally rich environments, as visually demonstrated in FIG 3.

elements.name: Boss Battles
elements.description: Symbolic boss battles in each country that embody specific cancer types (Chondrosarcoma, Ewing’s Sarcoma, Osteosarcoma), requiring players to use strategic tools and make treatment decisions.
elements.justification: The boss battles are a key gameplay mechanic that serves as a climactic educational challenge, allowing players to simulate diagnosis and treatment, reinforced by visual insights from FIG 5, 6, 7.

elements.name: Positive Simulated User Feedback
elements.description: The preliminary validation showed consistently strong reception across all four simulated user personas for CancerSB, particularly for its visual design, cultural sensitivity, and educational value.
elements.justification: This is the primary outcome of the paper's evaluation, indicating the perceived effectiveness and potential of CancerSB based on the novel preliminary validation method.

elements.name: Simulated Persona Feedback Questionnaire
elements.description: A 7-question questionnaire, based on established instruments (Curve, PSSUQ, GEQ, FSS, AttrakDiff), used to gather Likert scale ratings and open-ended comments from ChatGPT 4o representing mega-personas.
elements.justification: This artifact is the direct instrument used to collect data for the preliminary validation, providing the structured input for evaluating CancerSB's design and educational aspects.

elements.name: Reliance on Simulated User Feedback (Limitation)
elements.description: The primary limitation of the study is its preliminary validation relying solely on simulated user feedback generated by ChatGPT 4o, rather than direct testing with real human participants.
elements.justification: This limitation is crucial for understanding the scope and generalizability of the reported results, highlighting an area for future work and tempering the interpretation of the positive findings.
